_comment: Performance budgets for the GloWe static frontend (FR-GLOWE-026 AC9).
Enforced by scripts/measure.mjs, run in CI by .github/workflows/ci-glowe-perf.yml.
`criticalPathGzipKb` counts every render-blocking resource a browser must
fetch, parse and execute before first paint: <script src> without
defer/async/type=module, plus <link rel=stylesheet> without a non-screen
media attribute. `pageWeightKb` adds the HTML itself and every image the page
pulls in via . CSS url() images are reported separately, not counted: a
browser fetches one only when a selector matches, so folding them in made all
22 pages read as a uniform ~4.5 MB and hid which page actually regressed.
These gate the SOURCE tree, which is what this repo authors. The deploy step
(app/scripts/glowe-minify-hash.mjs, via web-postbuild) only shrinks it further
and content-hashes it, so a source-tree gate is the conservative one — it can
never pass something the shipped build would fail.
TWO numbers per metric: `budget` is the CI gate, set just above the current
measurement so a regression fails today; `target` is where the overhaul is
going, reported as a gap rather than enforced. Budgets ratchet DOWN, never up.
Raising one is a deliberate act belonging in its own PR with a stated reason.
Measured 2026-07-28 on staging after self-hosting the fonts: 34.3 KB critical
path over 2 blocking requests, 405.8 KB on index.html, 0 third-party origins.
Critical path is dominated by styles.css, which must block to avoid a flash of
unstyled content; the 33 @font-face rules inlined into it account for ~1.4 KB.
